screenLevelIssues.figmaValue: Main content container positioned with marginTop: 205, marginBottom: 34, and using justifyContent: 'space-between' internally.
screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen's vertical structure is defined by a main content container that is precisely positioned with a large top margin (205px) and a bottom margin (34px) to accommodate the home indicator. Inside this container, `justifyContent: 'space-between'` is used to push the text block to the top and the button block to the bottom. A common implementation error would be to use incorrect margins or to use `gap` instead of `space-between`, which would not adapt correctly to different screen heights.

The main content blocks (the top section with the logo and text, and the bottom section with the button) have a horizontal padding of 48px on each side. This creates the wide, spacious margins visible in the design. Using a smaller, more common padding value would make the content appear too close to the screen edges.

screenLevelIssues.figmaValue: A composite background with 3 layers: base color, a texture image with 8% opacity, and a top gradient overlay image.
screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen background is not a single element. It's composed of three layers that must be stacked correctly: 1) The base background color `#131313` (`colors.black[700]`). 2) A full-screen texture image (`image 149`) with an opacity of 8%. 3) A gradient overlay image (`Background Shape`) positioned at the top and centered horizontally. These background elements must be absolutely positioned to sit behind the main content without affecting the layout.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<View style={styles.screenContainer}>
  <Image
    source={require('path/to/texture_image.png')}
    style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, { opacity: 0.08 }]}
  />
  <Image
    source={require('path/to/gradient_overlay.png')}
    style={styles.gradientOverlay}
  />
  {/* ... rest of screen content ... */}
</View>

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  screenContainer: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: _designTokens.colors.black[700],
  },
  gradientOverlay: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    width: 481,
    height: 405,
    alignSelf: 'center',
  }
});

feedback.explanation: The screen's vertical structure is incorrect. The main content container must be positioned with a large top margin (205px) and a bottom margin (34px). Crucially, it must use `justifyContent: 'space-between'` to push the text block to the top and the button block to the bottom, ensuring it adapts correctly to different screen heights.

The main heading "Make your rent work for you→" is a single line in Figma with multiple colors. It must be implemented as a single `<Text>` component with nested `<Text>` spans to ensure correct line wrapping, styling, and accessibility, instead of using multiple separate Text components.
feedback.fixedCode:
<Text style={styles.headingBase}>
  Make your rent work for you
  <Text style={styles.headingArrow}>→</Text>
</Text>
